title: Speaking to Somebody
label: ch:hi-sambodhan
canDo: I can address somebody by name, in speech and on paper, and write a short message to a named reader.

payoff.summary: Write the whole message to a named reader from a purpose cue alone: the opening line that names them, two sentences underneath, and your own name at the foot.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these three atoms and the payoff assesses all three, with no model on the page.
